cases.sentence: И люди Иоава, вместе с керетитами и пелетитами и всеми ___, выступили под началом Авишая.
cases.explain: «могучими воинами» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Joab’s men went out after him, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites, and all the mighty men; and they went out of Jerusalem, to pursue Sheba the son of Bichri.

cases.sentence: Когда они находились у ___ в Гаваоне, Амаса вышел им навстречу.
cases.explain: «большой скалы» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

cases.sentence: На Иоаве была ___, и он был опоясан ремнем, на котором висел меч в ножнах.
cases.explain: «воинская одежда» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: When they were at the great stone which is in Gibeon, Amasa came to meet them. Joab was clothed in his apparel of war that he had put on, and on it was a sash with a sword fastened on his waist in its sheath; and as he went along it fell out.

cases.sentence: Они насыпали ___ у внешних укреплений города.
cases.explain: «осадный вал» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

cases.sentence: Они насыпали осадный вал у ___ города.
cases.explain: «внешних укреплений» — after the preposition «у», the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

cases.sentence: Когда они старались разрушить стену, 16 одна ___ крикнула со стены города:
cases.explain: «мудрая женщина» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: They came and besieged him in Abel of Beth Maacah, and they cast up a mound against the city, and it stood against the rampart; and all the people who were with Joab battered the wall, to throw it down.

cases.sentence: Женщина пошла ко всему народу со своим ___, и Шеве, сыну Бихри, отрубили голову и бросили ее Иоаву.
cases.explain: «мудрым советом» — after the preposition «со», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out to Joab. He blew the trumpet, and they were dispersed from the city, every man to his tent. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem to the king.
